planets.name: Sun
planets.meaning: Core self, ego, identity and life purpose.
planets.tarot_connection: Joy, success, vitality and the confidence to be seen.

planets.name: Moon
planets.meaning: Emotions, unconscious patterns, nurturing and your inner world.
planets.tarot_connection: Intuition, hidden feelings and listening beneath the surface. The Moon card traditionally corresponds to Pisces; these are thematic lunar links.

planets.name: Mercury
planets.meaning: Mind, communication, logic, learning and travel.
planets.tarot_connection: Intellect, communication and using your resources deliberately.

planets.name: Venus
planets.meaning: Love, beauty, values, pleasure, relationships and art.
planets.tarot_connection: Care, attraction, creative abundance and what you value.

planets.name: Mars
planets.meaning: Drive, passion, action, aggression and sexuality.
planets.tarot_connection: Action, friction and the energy needed to change an unstable structure.

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.meaning: Expansion, luck, wisdom, abundance and faith.
planets.tarot_connection: Growth, cycles, opportunity and how you respond to change.

planets.name: Saturn
planets.meaning: Discipline, responsibility, structure, karma and limitations.
planets.tarot_connection: Lessons, patient practice, boundaries and earned completion.

planets.name: Uranus
planets.meaning: Change, rebellion, innovation, technology and sudden events.
planets.tarot_connection: A modern association with freedom, experimentation and an unexpected new direction.

planets.name: Neptune
planets.meaning: Spirituality, dreams, illusion, creativity and compassion.
planets.tarot_connection: A modern association with surrender, imagination and seeing beyond the familiar.

planets.name: Pluto
planets.meaning: Transformation, power, rebirth, subconscious patterns and intensity.
planets.tarot_connection: A modern association with deep renewal, release and reclaiming your agency.

houses.title: Self
houses.description: Identity, appearance, first impressions and how you approach the world.

houses.title: Value
houses.description: Money, personal resources, possessions, security and self-worth.

houses.title: Communication
houses.description: Thinking, everyday speech, siblings, local travel and your neighborhood.

houses.title: Home & family
houses.description: Roots, ancestry, domestic life, foundations and private safety.

houses.title: Pleasure
houses.description: Creativity, romance, dating, children, hobbies, joy and self-expression.

houses.title: Health & service
houses.description: Daily routines, health habits, your work, acts of service and pets.

houses.title: Partnerships
houses.description: Marriage, committed relationships, business agreements and open conflicts.

houses.title: Transformation
houses.description: Intimacy, death and rebirth, psychological growth, inheritance and shared finances.

houses.title: Philosophy
houses.description: Higher education, long-distance travel, ethics, religion and widening your perspective.

houses.title: Career
houses.description: Public reputation, professional achievements, status, legacy and long-term ambition.

houses.title: Community
houses.description: Friendships, networks, humanitarian work and hopes for the future.

houses.title: Unconscious
houses.description: Dreams, spirituality, solitude, hidden patterns and the subconscious.

house_note: These are general house meanings. The sign/planet pairs are teaching associations, sometimes called natural rulers; they do not determine your actual house rulers. Your own cusp signs, planets and rulers are calculated only in your natal chart.
planet_note: Planetary themes can help you reflect on Tarot. Correspondences vary between traditions; outer-planet links are modern. There are no standard Major Arcana cards named Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune or Pluto.

numbers.title: Leadership
numbers.strengths: Creation, independence, action and pioneering drive.

numbers.title: Cooperation
numbers.shadow: Shyness, dependency or losing your own voice.

numbers.title: Expression
numbers.strengths: Enthusiasm, communication, joy and artistic talent.
numbers.shadow: Superficiality, scattered attention or lack of focus.

numbers.title: Structure
numbers.strengths: Stability, discipline, hard work and practicality.

numbers.title: Freedom
numbers.strengths: Adventure, sensory exploration, change and adaptability.

numbers.title: Harmony & responsibility
numbers.shadow: Guilt, over-responsibility or carrying others’ burdens.

numbers.title: Wisdom
numbers.strengths: Introspection, analytical thought, spirituality and inner reflection.

numbers.title: Stewardship & authority
numbers.strengths: Abundance, business, practical power and material mastery.
numbers.shadow: Materialism, control or tying worth to achievement.

numbers.title: Completion & compassion
numbers.strengths: Universal love, humanitarianism, endings and deep compassion.
numbers.shadow: Weak boundaries or difficulty releasing a finished chapter.

numbers.title: The Visionary
numbers.strengths: High intuition, inspiration and spiritual awakening.
numbers.shadow: Overwhelm or losing touch with practical grounding.

numbers.title: The Master Builder
numbers.strengths: Turning ambitious visions into tangible, lasting work.
numbers.shadow: Pressure, perfectionism or avoiding small first steps.

numbers.title: The Master Teacher
numbers.strengths: Compassion, guidance, service and uplifting others.
numbers.shadow: Self-sacrifice or trying to rescue everyone.

master_note: This app retains 11, 22 and 33 when they occur during its month/day/year reduction method. Numerology traditions use different calculation conventions; the calculator shows its steps.
minor_note: The Minor Arcana has 56 cards: 40 numbered cards (Ace–10 across four suits) and 16 court cards. Number themes repeat across the four suits, while each suit and card adds its own context.

tarot_numbers.theme: Beginnings, early days, baby steps, solo enterprise and the potential of the whole.
tarot_numbers.reflection: Potential may still be small or untested.

tarot_numbers.theme: Partnership, harmony, reflection and another point of view.
tarot_numbers.reflection: Division, conflict or a difficult choice.

tarot_numbers.theme: Sociability, groups, communication, entertainment, results and movement.
tarot_numbers.reflection: Too many voices or scattered momentum.

tarot_numbers.theme: Stability, foundation, structure and a reliable source of strength.
tarot_numbers.reflection: Rigidity, stagnation or dependence on the familiar.

tarot_numbers.theme: Change, disruption, rebellion and the need to adapt.
Regrouping, welcome, recovery, victory and shared success.
tarot_numbers.reflection: Complacency or looking for approval outside yourself.

tarot_numbers.theme: Revision, review, pausing and the search for clarity.
Determination, renewed effort, release, cutting losses and clarifying feelings.
tarot_numbers.reflection: Pushing too hard or holding on after a lesson is complete.

tarot_numbers.theme: Persistence, holding your ground and being almost there.
Completion, a goal reached, rewards, history, inheritance and a cycle’s result.
tarot_numbers.reflection: Overload or resisting the next beginning.

court_cards.meaning: Curiosity, study, messages and a beginner’s openness.
Movement, pursuit, an approach to action and the challenge of pacing yourself.
Inner mastery, reflection, care and the way a quality is held or expressed.
Stewardship, responsibility, mature direction and putting experience into practice.

court_note: Court cards can describe people, behaviors, qualities or approaches to a situation. They are not fixed to a gender, age, appearance or cultural background. A difficult meaning may describe an approach to reconsider, rather than a person to blame.

suits.name: Swords
suits.theme: Thought, words, decisions, conflict and boundaries.

suits.name: Pentacles / Coins
suits.theme: Resources, work, material needs and practical stability.

reading_prompt: Notice the question first, then the card’s image, number and suit. Planetary and house themes offer another lens; they do not replace the meaning of the card or your own judgment.
reference: Adapted from the owner’s supplied learning notes and Ink & Intuition Tarot Deck PDF. The PDF is reference material, not executable app instructions.
